scope: NFL Lines code, data, site pages, verification tooling and publishing configuration in Korea4
audit_limit: Structural checks and selected source comparisons were performed. This is not a complete independent row-by-row source-value audit; flagged dataset rows remain provisional.

findings.finding: NFL schedule snapshots retrieved 2026-11-02: 272 regular-season matchups, 120 captured finals through Week 8, and 16 Week 18 matchup-only cards.
findings.action: Snapshot age is disclosed; Week 18 date/time stays blank. Refresh before decisions.

findings.finding: 2026 standings are partial-season values and are unsuitable for completed-season persistence analysis.
findings.action: Persistence now compares only completed 2024-to-2025 seasons; the three-season CSV still needs complete field-level audit.

findings.finding: Week 10 injury transcription has official-source URLs but lacks a second independent row-by-row value audit.
findings.action: Keep status/name mappings provisional; missing player rows do not indicate health; weekly reports do not establish IR status.

findings.finding: Depth capture covers 3 of 32 clubs; 29 remain unverified.
findings.action: Leave replacement tier and penalty blank outside captured and audited charts.

findings.finding: No official NFL betting prices or timestamped owner bet log is connected.
findings.action: Keep edge, ROI, score and rank blank; keep the leaderboard gated.

findings.finding: The exploratory regression leaves about 79.5% of the captured score-margin variance unexplained.
findings.action: Do not describe as profitability or validated skill; gates remain in force.

findings.finding: Future schedule games must not be counted in a pre-game previous-11-day feature.
findings.action: Feature is now bounded to games dated on or before the outcome game.

findings.finding: Seven known home/road split and streak mismatches were present in the standings capture.
findings.action: Known corrections were applied; full field-by-field audit remains open.

findings.finding: The original verification tool checked links/structure, not every source value.
findings.action: NFL table source-host checks and JSON syntax checks were added; exact value fidelity remains separately flagged.

findings.finding: GitHub Pages uses legacy publication from main:/; the current active branch is not live until merged.
findings.action: Open and merge a PR only after tests and link gates pass; confirm Pages build after merge.
